project: Dead Channel 13 - Rain on the Glass

cues.title: Catwalk Rainwater Kick & Boxing Exchange
cues.notes: Tight boxing pocket and acid-jazz groove riding beneath skylight rain and elbow parries.

cues.title: Zero Beat: Frozen Raindrops & CRT Crash
cues.notes: Sudden vacuum drop on Masato finger snap; leave headroom for sub-bass thump and crashing CRT glass.

cues.title: 13-Second Phase-Tape Micro-Rewind
cues.notes: Nixie 13.000s rewind urgency; keep dialogue-range vocals stem ducked so Toma and Sora headset lines cut cleanly.

cues.title: Pulse-Shot & Dead-Fire Stained-Glass Clash
cues.notes: Full sakuga horn/slap-bass climax across the 8-second three-way clash and skylight shatter.

cues.title: Noir Aftermath on the Wet Steel Grate
cues.notes: Muted noir brass and wet Rhodes fade as rain resumes over stained-glass shards.
